airspace.zh: 依納米比亞環境、林業與觀光部2025年的說明，沒有官方許可，不得在國家公園內使用無人機；攜帶無人機的遊客，須在公園入口申報並登記。納米比亞民航局另有無人機的規定。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: According to Namibia's Ministry of Environment, Forestry and Tourism (2025), drones may not be used in the country's national parks without an official permit, and visitors carrying drones must declare and register them at the park gates. The Namibia Civil Aviation Authority has its own drone rules. Check the current rules before any real flight.

sossusvlei.note: Clay pan where the Tsauchab ends (24°44′S 15°22′E)

tagline.zh-Hant: 六千萬年前出現的沙漠、一千五百萬年前的砂岩、九百年的枯樹，到2013年的世界遺產
tagline.en: A desert begun 60 million years ago, ancient sandstone, 900-year-old trees and World Heritage in 2013

zh: 納米布沙海，在非洲西南部的大西洋岸，
位於納米比亞的納米布-諾克盧福國家公園。
en: The Namib Sand Sea lies on the Atlantic coast of south-western Africa,
in Namibia's Namib-Naukluft National Park.

zh: 大約六千萬年前，這裡就出現了最早的沙漠跡象；
一千六百萬到兩千萬年前，沙漠達到高峰。
en: The first signs of a desert here appeared about 60 million years ago;
it reached its peak 16 to 20 million years ago.

zh: 塞斯瑞姆一帶的宗達布砂岩，
是大約一千五百萬年前的沙海，固結成了岩石。
en: The Tsondab Sandstone around Sesriem
is the sand sea of about 15 million years ago, turned to stone.

zh: 岩層裡保存著化石，
主要是植物根部的痕跡和白蟻的巢穴。
en: It holds fossils,
mostly traces of plant roots and termite structures.

zh: 塞斯瑞姆峽谷，大約在五百萬年前的上新世形成，
長約一公里，最深約三十公尺。
en: Sesriem Canyon formed about 5 million years ago, in the Pliocene;
it is about a kilometre long and up to 30 metres deep.

zh: 早期的阿非利卡移民，
把六條劍羚皮帶接在一起，才能從峽谷底打到水。
en: Early Afrikaans settlers
joined six oryx-hide belts to draw water up from the canyon floor.

zh: 這些沙子的旅程，從奧蘭治河上游的侵蝕開始，
從內陸被搬運了數千公里。
en: The journey of this sand begins with erosion at the headwaters of the Orange River,
carried thousands of kilometres from the interior.

zh: 河流把沙帶到海岸，再由南風與沿岸流往北推送。
這套搬運沙子的系統，已經運作了五百多萬年。
en: Rivers brought it to the coast, and southerly winds and longshore drift pushed it north.
This sand-moving system has been at work for more than 5 million years.

zh: 托普納爾人，是納米比亞最古老的居民之一，
幾百年來，一直使用這片土地和它的資源。
en: The Topnaar are among the oldest inhabitants of Namibia,
and have used this land and its resources for centuries.

zh: 他們採集野生的納拉瓜果實，
這是沙漠裡重要的食物。
en: They harvest the fruit of the wild !nara melon,
an important food in the desert.

zh: 索蘇斯維旁的死亡谷，枯樹大約有九百年的歷史，
大約在六、七百年前死去。
en: Near Sossusvlei, the dead trees of Deadvlei are about 900 years old;
they died some 600 to 700 years ago.

zh: 沙丘擋住了查烏查布河，水再也流不到那片窪地，
樹木因此缺水而死。
en: Dunes cut the pan off from the Tsauchab River,
and the trees died for lack of water.

zh: 2013年6月21日，納米布沙海列入世界遺產，
同時符合全部四項自然遺產標準。
en: On 21 June 2013 the Namib Sand Sea was inscribed as a World Heritage Site,
meeting all four natural criteria.

zh: 依國際自然保護聯盟的說法，
這是十年來第一次有遺產地同時符合四項標準。
en: According to IUCN
it was the first such inscription in ten years.

zh: 在這裡，探勘鑽石的許可已被取消，
採礦在遺產範圍內是被禁止的。
en: Diamond prospecting licences here are being cancelled,
and mining is prohibited in the property.

zh: 從六千萬年前開始的沙漠，
到今天，這片沙海還在慢慢地移動。
en: A desert that began 60 million years ago
is still, today, a sea of sand slowly on the move.

tagline.zh-Hant: 納馬語的「不歸」、第45公里的沙丘，與非洲最常被拍攝的地方之一
tagline.en: A Nama "no return", a dune at kilometre 45 and one of the most photographed places in Africa

zh: 「索蘇斯維」大約是「死路沼澤」的意思。
「維」是阿非利卡語的沼澤，「索蘇斯」是納馬語的「不歸」。
en: Sossusvlei means roughly "dead-end marsh":
"vlei" is Afrikaans for marsh, and "sossus" comes from Nama, meaning "no return".

zh: 「死亡谷」的原名 Deadvlei，意思其實是「死去的沼澤」；
翻成「死亡山谷」，是誤譯。
en: The name Deadvlei means "dead marsh";
"dead valley" is a mistranslation.

zh: 塞斯瑞姆大門，
是遊客進入國家公園前往索蘇斯維的主要入口。
en: The Sesriem gate
is the main entrance to the park for visitors heading to Sossusvlei.

zh: 清晨，熱氣球從大門出發；
公園四分之三的遊客，都集中在塞斯瑞姆這一帶。
en: Hot-air balloons set off from the gate early in the morning;
three-quarters of the park's visitors are concentrated around Sesriem.

zh: 從大門到索蘇斯維約六十六公里：
前六十公里是柏油路，最後六公里是沙地，要四輪傳動車。
en: From the gate to Sossusvlei is about 66 km:
about 60 km of tarmac, then 6 km of sand that needs a four-wheel drive.

zh: 45號沙丘的名字，
來自它就在這條路的第四十五公里。
en: Dune 45 takes its name
from its place at kilometre 45 of this road.

zh: 它高超過一百七十公尺，
是遊客很喜歡停下來的地方。
en: It rises more than 170 metres,
and is a popular stop for visitors.

zh: 2023年，索蘇斯維有十九萬八千多名遊客。
它是撒哈拉以南非洲最常被拍攝的地方之一。
en: In 2023 Sossusvlei had more than 198,000 visitors.
It is among the most photographed places in sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 電影《The Cell》和《The Fall》，
都有部分在死亡谷拍攝。
en: The films The Cell and The Fall
were partly shot in Deadvlei.

zh: 離停車場約四公里的隱藏谷，
是這一帶最少人去的窪地。
en: Hiddenvlei, about 4 km from the parking area,
is the least visited of the pans here.

zh: 觀光也帶來壓力：
違法又有害的越野駕駛、衛生與污染問題。
en: Tourism brings pressures too:
illegal and harmful off-road driving, sanitation and pollution.

zh: 依納米比亞環境部2025年的說明，
沒有官方許可，國家公園內不准使用無人機。
en: According to Namibia's environment ministry in 2025,
drones may not be used in national parks without an official permit.

zh: 帶著無人機的遊客，
也必須在公園入口申報並登記。
en: Visitors carrying drones
must also declare and register them at the park gates.

zh: 托普納爾人在這片土地上生活了好幾百年；
今天，它也是全世界旅人的目的地。
en: The Topnaar have lived on this land for centuries;
today it is also a destination for travellers from around the world.

zh: 名字、道路與鏡頭，
把這片沙海帶到了世界各地。
en: Names, roads and cameras
have carried this sea of sand around the world.

tagline.zh-Hant: 霧是主要的水源、八成以上特有的蛛形類、背上收集霧水的甲蟲，與劍羚、跳羚和鴕鳥
tagline.en: Fog as the main water source, endemic arachnids, a beetle that drinks fog, and oryx, springbok and ostriches

zh: 冷的本格拉洋流，讓這裡一年的雨量不到五十公釐，
也在海岸形成寬達五十公里的霧帶。
en: The cold Benguela Current keeps rainfall here under 50 mm a year
and creates a coastal fog belt up to 50 km wide.

zh: 在這片沙海裡，霧是最主要的水源；
動植物都演化出了收集霧水的方法。
en: In the sand sea fog is the main source of water;
plants and animals have adapted to harvest it.

zh: 納米布沙漠甲蟲，
靠背上的小突起，在清晨收集霧裡的水。
en: The Namib Desert beetle
collects water from the morning fog with the bumps on its back.

zh: 只在沙海裡才有的物種，包括八種植物，
占沙海植物的百分之五十三。
en: Species found only in the sand sea include eight plants,
53% of its plant species.

zh: 蛛形類有三十七種是特有種，占了百分之八十四；
昆蟲有一百零八種，占百分之五十二。
en: Thirty-seven arachnids are endemic, 84% of those here;
so are 108 insects, 52%.

zh: 爬蟲類有八種特有種，占百分之四十四；
還有一種鳥和兩種哺乳類。
en: Eight reptiles are endemic, 44% of the total,
along with one bird and two mammals.

zh: 較大的動物有劍羚、跳羚和鴕鳥，
也有胡狼、囓齒類、爬蟲類和許多小節肢動物。
en: Larger animals include oryx, springbok and ostriches,
alongside jackals, rodents, reptiles and many small arthropods.

zh: 有些無脊椎動物，
甚至能在沙裡「游泳」和「潛水」。
en: Some invertebrates
even "swim" and "dive" through the sand.

zh: 查烏查布河是一條季節河，
只有在諾克盧福山區難得下大雨時才有水。
en: The Tsauchab is a seasonal river,
flowing only after rare heavy rain in the Naukluft Mountains.

zh: 河道兩旁，長著一條綠色的植物帶，
季節性的河水，也會把外來植物的種子帶進來。
en: A green band of plants grows along its bed,
and its seasonal floods also carry in the seeds of invasive alien plants.

zh: 外來的阿根廷蟻和菜粉蝶，
已經侵擾了百歲蘭和納拉瓜的群落。
en: Introduced Argentine ants and cabbage butterflies
have infested colonies of welwitschia and !nara.

zh: 北方海岸的三明治港，是候鳥重要的中繼站；
2005年，最多記錄到四十萬隻水鳥。
en: Sandwich Harbour on the northern coast is a key stopover for migrating birds;
up to 400,000 waterbirds were counted there in 2005.

zh: 氣候變遷與上游的用水，
是這裡潛在的重大威脅。
en: Climate change and water use upstream
are rated high potential threats here.

zh: 在幾乎不下雨的沙漠裡，
這麼多生命，靠的就是海上飄來的霧。
en: In a desert where it hardly rains,
so much life depends on fog drifting in from the sea.

zh: 霧、沙與偶爾流過的河水，
撐起了這片看似空曠的沙海。
en: Fog, sand and the occasional river
hold up this sea of sand that looks so empty.

tagline.zh-Hant: 三百多萬公頃的沙海、十六種沙丘、越老越紅的沙，與三百多公尺高的「大老爹」
tagline.en: Over three million hectares of sand, sixteen dune types, sand that reddens with age and the 325 m Big Daddy

zh: 世界遺產的範圍超過三百萬公頃，
另有約九十萬公頃的緩衝區。
en: The World Heritage Site covers over three million hectares,
with a buffer zone of about 900,000 hectares.

zh: 沙丘地占了百分之八十四，
大約是納米布-諾克盧福國家公園的六成。
en: Dune fields make up 84% of it,
and it covers about 60% of the Namib-Naukluft National Park.

zh: 這裡辨認出十六種不同的沙丘：
海岸是橫向沙丘，中間是線形沙丘，東邊是星形沙丘。
en: Sixteen dune types are recognised here:
transverse dunes on the coast, linear dunes in the centre and star dunes in the east.

zh: 納米布沙漠，沿著納米比亞海岸，
形成一條寬八十到一百二十公里的帶。
en: The Namib runs along the coast of Namibia
as a belt 80 to 120 km wide.

zh: 45號沙丘的沙，大約有五百萬年；
是奧蘭治河從喀拉哈里帶出來，再被風吹到這裡的。
en: The sand of Dune 45 is about 5 million years old,
carried from the Kalahari by the Orange River and then blown here by the wind.

zh: 沙丘的橘紅色，來自沙粒上的鐵慢慢氧化；
沙丘越老，顏色就越紅。
en: The orange of the dunes comes from iron slowly oxidising;
the older the dune, the redder it gets.

zh: 往西，查烏查布河朝沙海深處流去，
全長約一百五十公里。
en: To the west the Tsauchab River runs into the heart of the sand sea,
about 150 km long in all.

zh: 它在索蘇斯維結束，
這裡是一個沒有出口的內流盆地。
en: It ends at Sossusvlei,
a basin with no outflow.

zh: 附近最高的沙丘「大老爹」，
高約三百二十五公尺。
en: The tallest dune nearby, Big Daddy,
is about 325 metres high.

zh: 死亡谷四周的沙丘，
被認為是世界上最高的沙丘之一。
en: The dunes around Deadvlei
are said to be among the highest in the world.

zh: 從太空看，查烏查布河留下的鹽沉積，
在衛星影像裡是一片亮白。
en: Seen from space,
the salt deposits of the Tsauchab show up bright white in satellite images.

zh: 東邊的塞斯瑞姆峽谷，有些地方只有兩公尺寬；
峽谷裡有一段終年有水，動物會來這裡喝水。
en: Sesriem Canyon to the east is only two metres wide in places;
one stretch holds water all year, and animals come to drink.

zh: 一千萬到五百萬年前，曾有一段較濕的時期，
在大斷崖東邊留下了河流沉積。
en: Between 10 and 5 million years ago a wetter spell
left river deposits east of the Great Escarpment.

zh: 北邊的奎塞布河，
是沙海的北界。
en: The Kuiseb River
forms the northern edge of the sand sea.

zh: 風把沙子堆成一座座山，
這片沙的海，還在慢慢改變形狀。
en: The wind piles the sand into mountains,
and this sea of sand keeps slowly changing shape.
